Alex / Priya — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap + next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope for our hosted control plane and delivery of audit reports to customers via our secure portal. I attached a short one-page SOC 2 summary for your security team.
- Encryption: All customer data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest. By default keys are managed by Redwood using cloud KMS.
- Customer-managed keys: We support customer-managed keys (CMK) via AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault for private deployments and Dedicated in-cloud clusters. We also have an HSM-backed option for customers with higher FIPS requirements.
- Vendor questionnaire: I can kick off the vendor security questionnaire and pre-fill details we already have; I attached the questionnaire stub you mentioned.

Open questions I captured for your security team:
1) Is a vault/HSM required for encryption at rest, or is cloud KMS acceptable?
2) Do you require a specific key rotation cadence or do you want Redwood to follow standard 90-day rotation?
3) Any additional compliance requirements beyond SOC 2 / GDPR / HIPAA that we should call out?

Next steps (proposed):
- I will send the SOC 2 summary + pre-filled questionnaire by EOD today.
- Camila (engineering) will follow up with a note on technical integration for CMKs and HSM options.
- Schedule a short sync with your security engineer to walk through the KMS/HSM flow if helpful.

Thanks — talk soon.

Alex — quick tech note from engineering: 

- CMK flow: For Dedicated and Private deployments we integrate with your cloud provider KMS using a customer-supplied key (BYOK). The service encrypts model artifacts and customer data at rest with data keys that are wrapped by the CMK; the CMK never leaves the KMS. We maintain only wrapped keys and ephemeral unwrapped keys in volatile memory during operations.
- HSM option: We offer an HSM-backed option (FIPS 140-2 level 3 certified HSMs) via partner HSM providers for on-prem / VPC deployments. Attestation: we can provide HSM attestation reports (certificate chains) and support TLS client cert auth to the HSM gateway.
- Rotation: rotation schedules are configurable at the project level; we support API-driven rotation (30/60/90+ days) and can also integrate with your key management policies for automatic rotation triggers.

I'll pull together a one-page architecture diagram and a short bulleted FAQ for CMK/HSM and drop it to the Drive link Marissa shared.

—
